panel.label: Accessibility
panel.name: accessibility

slider.label: Text size:
slider.name: a11y_font_size_slider
slider.tool_tip: Points added to every interface font size (0 = normal). Applies right away; the same setting as Preferences > Skins > Font size adjustment.

slider.label: Interface size:
slider.name: a11y_ui_scale_slider
slider.tool_tip: Size of the whole interface: windows, buttons, icons and text together (1 = normal). Applies when you press OK; the same setting as Preferences > Advanced > UI size.

check_box.label: Reduced motion
check_box.name: reduced_motion_check
check_box.tool_tip: Fewer moving and fading things on screen. Applies right away.

panel.text: Camera moves (focus, sit, appearance) jump instead of gliding, mouse wheel zoom steps without easing, the pie menu opens without its pop-up animation, notifications disappear without fading, and animated chat pictures stay on their first frame.

check_box.label: High contrast
check_box.name: high_contrast_check
check_box.tool_tip: White text on black windows with a bright yellow accent. Applies right away.

panel.text: White text on black windows, bright borders and a bright yellow accent. Your own colours (Preferences > Skins > Your colours) are kept and come back when you turn this off. Images drawn by the skin, such as active tabs and check boxes, keep their colours.

check_box.label: Dyslexia-friendly font (OpenDyslexic)
check_box.name: dyslexic_font_check
check_box.tool_tip: Use the OpenDyslexic font for the whole interface. Applies right away. Turning it off goes back to the normal font; other fonts are in Preferences > Skins > Font.

panel.text: Not available: the OpenDyslexic font is not installed with this build.
